detailed_description: One Rep Max Calculator - Estimate a strength training one-rep max from lifted weight, completed reps, and metric or imperial units. The calculator shows Epley, Brzycki, and Lombardi estimates, then averages them into a single headline value so you can compare training loads without manually running each formula. Use the result conservatively and prioritize safe lifting technique.
usage_steps: Enter the weight lifted and the number of reps completed
Review the average one-rep max plus Epley, Brzycki, and Lombardi values
Copy the estimate or adjust reps and weight to compare another set
usage_examples: Estimate a max from a 5-rep working set
Compare how different rep counts change the formula average
Plan conservative training percentages without testing a true max

faqs.question: Is the One Rep Max Calculator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The calculator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Which formulas are included?
faqs.answer: The result includes Epley, Brzycki, and Lombardi estimates, plus an average of the three.

faqs.question: Is the estimate safe to use as my actual max?
faqs.answer: Treat it as an estimate only. Fatigue, form, exercise choice, and training history can change what is safe on a given day.
